description: Mortgage Loans page sections, in the order they appear: hero, the partner logos, the rates band, what we help with, how it works, why Think SME, fixed or floating, the Google Reviews slider, the FAQ and the final CTA. This page adds no new section to the theme — every block on it is one another page already draws. The three card grids are the same component with different values, so their fields are grouped by section above. The testimonials_*, faq_* and cta_* field names repeat the other pages’ names under different keys, which is what lets template-parts/testimonials.php, faq.php and cta.php stay page-agnostic; the questions here are the site-wide “FAQs” posts. Everything is flat fields because ACF free has no Repeater — quantities are fixed by the layout, and empty entries are skipped rather than rendered blank. Leave a field empty and the design’s own copy renders instead: because the theme treats an empty value as “use the design default”, a field that ships with copy cannot be blanked from here, only replaced.
